app.title: Sensitivity
page.overview_intro: Connect a Xiaomi phone in “Connect with Mi Assistant” mode. Sensitivity validates official packages before anything is written.
connection.refresh_hint: Refresh after the phone is waiting for Mi Assistant.
guide.rom: 1  Use the official Recovery ROM for this exact device and region.
guide.awake: 2  Keep the computer awake and use a reliable USB cable.
guide.wipe: 3  Read every wipe warning before approving it.
page.flash_intro: The package is checked before the USB transfer starts.
rom.only_official: Recovery ROM ZIP files are supported here. Fastboot packages are not.
status.ready: Choose a ROM file to begin
page.recovery_intro: These commands are sent directly to the selected stock recovery.
reboot.exit_hint: Exit recovery and start the installed system.
erase.warning_short: Permanent. The phone is formatted and then rebooted.
page.diagnostics_intro: Check the backend, USB interface, WinUSB access, and local ADB coexistence.
setting.resolve_adb_hint: Ask before stopping local ADB when it blocks recovery.
setting.stop_adb_hint: Enable only if recovery cannot be reached while ADB is running.
about.description: Direct USB recovery for Xiaomi devices.
error.backend_missing_detail: sensitivity-cli.exe was not found beside the application.
connection.phone_hint: On the phone, open Connect with Mi Assistant and reconnect USB.
connection.select_hint: Select the interface, then read its device information.
error.no_recovery_detail: Check recovery mode, the cable, and the WinUSB driver.
dialog.adb_owns: ADB may be using this interface
dialog.adb_owns_detail: Sensitivity can stop the local ADB server once and retry. Other Android debugging sessions on this computer will disconnect.
status.handshake_ok: The direct USB handshake and device queries succeeded.
dialog.choose_rom_detail: Select an official Recovery ROM ZIP before continuing.
dialog.no_recovery_detail: Connect and select a recovery device first.
dialog.validate_flash_detail: Sensitivity will verify the package with Xiaomi before starting the transfer. You will get another warning if validation requires a data wipe.
status.transfer_ok: Recovery accepted the complete ROM transfer.
status.cancelled_detail: Sensitivity requested a graceful close of the USB session.
dialog.wipe_required: This flash will erase all user data
dialog.wipe_required_detail: Xiaomi requires a permanent data wipe for this package.
status.reboot_detail: The phone should leave recovery shortly.
dialog.erase_confirm_detail: This cannot be undone. Sensitivity will format the phone and request a reboot.
status.erase_detail: Recovery accepted the format and reboot commands.
status.diagnostics_ready: USB and recovery communication are ready.
status.diagnostics_review: Review the report for the corrective action.
status.report_copied_detail: The diagnostic report is on the clipboard.
error.no_interface_detail: No Mi Assistant recovery interface was found. Reconnect the phone after opening Connect with Mi Assistant.
error.usb_open_detail: Windows could not open the recovery interface. Check WinUSB setup, close other phone tools, or allow Sensitivity to stop local ADB.
error.validation_http_detail: Xiaomi validation could not be reached. Check the internet connection and try again without changing the ROM.
page.roms_intro: Check which packages are compatible with the connected phone.
latest_rom.warning: The package is checked against Xiaomi's MD5 before it is used.
allowed_roms.none: No package query has been run yet.
setting.profile_hint: Only enter these values if recovery cannot report them correctly.
status.rom_not_found_detail: Choose a ZIP manually or download a package for the connected phone.
dialog.flash_latest_detail: Sensitivity downloads the package, verifies it, and asks again if a wipe is needed.
flow.intro: Two steps, from recovery to flash.
flow.connect_hint: Choose the Mi Assistant recovery interface, then read its details.
flow.package_hint: Download a package for this phone or select a ZIP already on the computer. Sensitivity checks it before transfer.
flow.flash_hint: Sensitivity checks the package before transfer and asks again if a wipe is needed.
rom.select_hint: Download a package, use a ZIP already in the folder, or browse for one.
